verdict.rationale: Jules supports delegating tasks via a GitHub issue label and lets you send follow-up messages to an active agent session, and docs mention embedding Jules into chat tools like Slack via the API for custom workflows; a community user even built a personal integration to dispatch tasks from VS Code chat. However, there's no evidence of a native, first-party 'tag @Jules in a chat thread' experience — it requires custom API wiring rather than an out-of-box chat mention feature. Missing for 10: official native chat-platform integration (e.g. Slack/Teams) with @-mention support, and evidence of in-thread back-and-forth discussion beyond simple message sending.
